title: Family and friends
titleJp: {家族|かぞく}と{友達|ともだち}

canDos.text: Show family photos and describe each person: what they're like, what they're good at, and what you think of them.
Understand a friend talking about their family and match the people they describe to a photo.
Ask for and give permission when visiting someone's home (may I come in, sit here, take a photo?).
Write a short message to a friend about your week: who you met or called, and a few things you did.

task.goal: You each hold half of the names for a family photo; by describing the people and what they are like, work out who everyone is.

roles.a: Has the names of the people on the left of the photo (card A)
roles.b: Has the names of the people on the right of the photo (card B)

capstone.title: Visiting the family
capstone.brief: Spend an afternoon with a friend's family (one of you plays the host): ask permission to come in and sit down, describe the people in a family photo, say what you think of the food and the house, and afterwards tell each other who you met and what they were like.
